description: chrony_exporter metrics for the NTP server. Note: chrony_exporter has no leap-status metric, so that stat from the plan is omitted; 'system time offset' uses chrony_tracking_system_time_seconds and 'RMS offset' uses chrony_tracking_rms_offset_seconds.

panels.description: Includes metrics/log shipping to VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs, not just NTP traffic. 48-byte NTP payload + 8 UDP + 20 IPv4 headers = 76 bytes per packet; dropped (rate-limited) requests get no reply. IPv6 packets are 96 bytes so this slightly underestimates.
